item.title: TI multiaxial sensor targets higher EV inverter accuracy
item.summary: Texas Instruments (TI) has introduced the TMCS2100-Q1, a multiaxial coreless Hall-effect current sensor aimed at improving current measurement in hybrid and electric vehicle traction inverters. The company says the device combines two-axis magnetic-field measurement with a proprietary algorithm to deliver higher accuracy without the size and weight of conventional magnetic-core solutions.
